description: Controlled routing benchmark settings (rmc route benchmark). A run starts two billed headless Claude Code sessions and only runs with --approve, given after the user explicitly agrees.

modes.direct: Do this task yourself in the main session. Do not delegate to any agent.
modes.delegated: Delegate this task to one RM Context agent, in the foreground: first run {route}, show its Notice line, then call the Agent tool with the agent and model it prints. Do not do the task yourself beyond checking the agent's result.
